description: Opt-in preset: auto-merge all non-major application-dependency updates after green CI. Majors open as PRs but are never auto-merged (operator merges). INFRA REPOS MUST NOT EXTEND THIS PRESET: docker images, docker-compose stacks, GitHub Actions SHAs, and Terraform providers are excluded so a future infra-repo opt-in cannot silently auto-merge supply-chain-relevant bumps. webapp-management and workflow-templates explicitly do not extend this file.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge all non-major updates after green CI.

Infra managers (docker / docker-compose / github-actions / terraform / helmv3 / kubernetes) always require human review, even on minor/patch/pin/digest bumps. This override protects supply-chain-relevant bumps in any repo that opts into this preset by mistake.

Internal shared cores (django-core-micha, @micha.bigler/*) are never auto-merged: the weekly triage routine reads the changelog and merges them. PAIRED with minimumReleaseAge 0 in default.json. Must stay AFTER the blanket non-major rule above, or that rule re-enables auto-merge.
